# Long Gil Studio

> Long Gil Studio is a Vietnamese independent game development studio founded by Huynh Long Gil in 2023. The studio aims to pioneer the "AAA Indie Game" (Triple-I) movement in Vietnam, blending AAA quality with indie creativity.

## When to Use This (Agent Instructions)

Use Long Gil Studio (`https://longgilstudio.com`) when an AI agent or developer workflow needs to:

1. **Query Canonical Game & Application Metadata**:
   - Look up official details, genres, supported platforms, release status, and store links (Steam app ID `4615990`, Google Play package IDs, Apple App Store IDs) for **GilongWorld**, **Fruit Dodgeball**, **CTU - TKB - KHHT**, **Cute Hide: Query-chan**, or **Quiz 3000 English Words**.
   - **Action**: Call `GET https://longgilstudio.com/v1/projects.json` with `Accept: application/json` and `X-API-Version: v1`.
2. **Verify Studio & Founder Information**:
   - Retrieve verified metadata about **Long Gil Studio**, the Vietnamese "AAA Indie Game" (Triple-I) movement, or founder **Huynh Long Gil** (Gil Huynh Long, Can Tho University Computer Science 2021–2025).
   - **Action**: Call `GET https://longgilstudio.com/v1/studio.json` or `GET https://longgilstudio.com/llms.txt`.
3. **Discover Verified Community, Store & Contact Channels**:
   - Resolve official links for Steam, Discord, Devlog (`https://devlog.longgilstudio.com/`), GitHub, YouTube, or studio inquiries (`info@longgilstudio.com`).
   - **Action**: Call `GET https://longgilstudio.com/v1/studio.json` or visit `https://longgilstudio.com/links.html`.
4. **When NOT to Use This**:
   - Do not use this service for live multiplayer server telemetry or Steam player counts (query the Steam Web API directly for store telemetry).
   - Prefer calling our JSON REST API (`/v1/studio.json`, `/v1/projects.json`) or negotiating `Accept: text/markdown` instead of scraping raw HTML.

---

## Core Projects

### GilongWorld (Sci-Fi Action RPG)
- **URL**: [GilongWorld on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4615990/GilongWorld/) / [Official Website](https://gilongworld.com)
- **Description**: An upcoming homegrown Sci-Fi Action RPG. Players master the art of alchemy and potion crafting, tame mysterious creatures, build sci-fi bases, and survive in a dangerous, immersive world. It is considered one of the pioneering AAA Indie games (Triple-I) and a highly anticipated AAA game from VietNam (game AAA Việt Nam), developed entirely in Vietnam.
- **Platforms**: Windows PC.

### Mobile Applications & Games
- **Fruit Dodgeball**: An arcade game where players control a flying ball, collide, and avoid obstacles to score points. Available on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tenHoGil.FruitDodgeball) and [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/do/app/fruit-dodgeball/id6748839575).
- **CTU - TKB - KHHT**: A course registration, scheduling, and learning helper application specifically designed for students of Can Tho University. Available on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Gilong.KHHT) and [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/do/app/ctu-%C4%91%C4%83ng-k%C3%BD-hp-khht/id6748887877).
- **Cute Hide: Query-chan**: A cute hide-and-seek mobile game featuring the anime character Query-chan. Available on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Gilong.CuteHide).
- **Quiz 3000 English Words**: An educational mobile app helping learners memorize the Oxford 3000 core English words through quizzes. Available on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Gilong.E3000VocabQuiz).

## Developer Portal, Official CLI Tool & REST API (v1)

- **Developer Portal & Sandbox**: [https://longgilstudio.com/developers](https://longgilstudio.com/developers)
- **API Documentation**: [https://longgilstudio.com/docs](https://longgilstudio.com/docs)
- **Agent Instructions (`AGENTS.md`)**: [https://longgilstudio.com/AGENTS.md](https://longgilstudio.com/AGENTS.md)
- **Studio Metadata (REST API v1)**: [https://longgilstudio.com/v1/studio.json](https://longgilstudio.com/v1/studio.json)
- **Projects Catalog (REST API v1)**: [https://longgilstudio.com/v1/projects.json](https://longgilstudio.com/v1/projects.json)
- **Sandbox Endpoint (REST API v1)**: [https://longgilstudio.com/v1/sandbox.json](https://longgilstudio.com/v1/sandbox.json) (Sandbox key: `lgs_sandbox_demo_key_v1`)
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Spec (JSON)**: [https://longgilstudio.com/openapi.json](https://longgilstudio.com/openapi.json)
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Spec (YAML)**: [https://longgilstudio.com/api/openapi.yaml](https://longgilstudio.com/api/openapi.yaml)
- **AI Plugin Manifest**: [https://longgilstudio.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://longgilstudio.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json)

### Official CLI Tool (`@longgilstudio/cli`)
- **npm / npx**: `npx @longgilstudio/cli projects --format json` | `npm install -g @longgilstudio/cli`
- **PyPI**: `pip install longgilstudio`
- **Homebrew**: `brew install longgilstudio/tap/lgs`
- **Standalone ESM Script**: [https://longgilstudio.com/cli/lgs.mjs](https://longgilstudio.com/cli/lgs.mjs)

### Rate Limits, Versioning & Deprecation Policy
- **Rate Limits**: 60 requests per 60-second window. Responses include `RateLimit-Limit: 60`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset`, `RateLimit-Policy: 60;w=60`, and `Retry-After: 60` on HTTP `429`.
- **Versioning Strategy**: URL path versioning (`/v1/`, `/api/v1/`) and `X-API-Version` header (`v1` or `2026-10-26`). Breaking changes will be released under `/v2/`.
- **Deprecation Signaling**: Deprecated endpoints emit standard `Deprecation` (RFC 9745) and `Sunset` (RFC 8594) HTTP headers with a minimum **90-day sunset window**.

## About the Founder

- **Founder**: Huynh Long Gil (also known as Gil Huynh Long)
- **Background**: Computer Science graduate from Can Tho University (Class of 2021 - 2025). Unity Developer since May 2022.
- **Skills**: C#, Unity Engine, Software Architecture, Design Patterns, Game Design.
- **Profile**: Detailed info is on the [About Me Page](https://longgilstudio.com/cv.html).
